title: Islam Ke Buniadi Rukn Kitne Hain?
urdu: اسلام کی بنیاد پانچ چیزوں پر رکھی گئی ہے۔
english: Islam is built upon five pillars.
explanation: Shahadah, Nimaz, Zakat, Sawm (Roza), aur Hajj Islam ke 5 arkan hain.

steps.title: Sawal Parhein
steps.detail: Sawal aur char options mein se durust jawab chunein.

steps.title: Wazahat Dekhein
steps.detail: Jawab submit karne ke baad hawala aur mukhtasar wazahat parhein.

title: Quran Ki Pehli Wahi Kis Surah Ki Aayaat Mein Nazil Hui?
urdu: پڑھ اپنے رب کے نام سے جس نے پیدا کیا۔
english: Read in the name of your Lord who created.
explanation: Ghar-e-Hira mein Surah Al-Alaq ki shuruati 5 aayaat pehli wahi ke taur par nazil huin.

steps.title: Option Muntakhib Karein
steps.detail: Diye gaye options mein se sahi surah ka naam select karein.

steps.title: Score Update Karein
steps.detail: Har durust jawab par score barhayein aur hawala note karein.

title: Raat Din Mein Kul Kitni Farz Nimazein Hain?
arabic: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَابًا مَوْقُوتًا
urdu: بے شک نماز مومنوں پر مقررہ وقت کے مطابق فرض ہے۔
english: Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers a decree of specified times.
explanation: Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, aur Isha — rozana 5 farz nimazein hain.

steps.title: Jawab Chunein
steps.detail: 5 farz nimazon ka durust option select karein.

steps.title: Nimaz Guide Se Jorhein
steps.detail: Tafseeli tareeqa dekhne ke liye Tareeqa Guides section kholein.
